We start rebuilding your aerobic engine today with non-impact Zone 2 cycling to kickstart your CTL ramp safely.

priority_1.workout_details: 10 min warmup @ 130W, 45 min steady Zone 2 @ 155-165W maintaining 85-95 RPM, 5 min cool-down @ 110W. Total time: 60 mins.
priority_1.reason: Top priority to safely reintroduce cardiovascular stimulus and begin CTL progression without joint impact after a 3-week break.

priority_2.workout_details: 30 min easy Zone 2 jog. Followed by 4 x 15-second relaxed strides at 5km pace on flat ground (45 sec walk recovery). 5 min cool-down walk.
priority_2.reason: Secondary alternative if running is preferred; keeps impact load light while re-engaging fast-twitch muscle fibers for 5km goals.

priority_3.workout_details: 3x5 Barbell Back Squats (70kg), 3x6 Overhead Press (40kg), 3x8 Sandbag Clean & Press (50kg), 3x12 Kettlebell Swings (20kg), 3x12 Hanging Leg Raises.
priority_3.reason: Third choice option to build structural integrity, core stability, and leg torque to support cycling power when endurance volume is low.
